name: Thieving Amalgam
oracle_text:
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, you manifest the top card of that player's library. (Put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Whenever a creature you control but don't own dies, its owner loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, you manifest the top card of that player's library. (Put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)

needs.what: a manifest whose source library and controlling player differ: the trigger's controller puts the top card of another player's library (the active opponent, bound by an upkeep trigger with controller: opponent) onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 under the effect controller's control, turnable face up for its mana cost if it is a creature card

The upkeep trigger and the second sentence (creature_dies filtered controller you, owner opponent, lose_life/gain_life) look expressible
